adapter_metadata.noise_key: SHA256(seed, question ID), independent of answer text
adapter_metadata.noise_generation: CPU float32 truncated normal, fixed 64-token blocks; then cast to model dtype
adapter_metadata.noise_coupling: same question shares identical positional initial states across options and depths
adapter_metadata.paper_rng_difference: Paper seed and sample ordering are not specified; this fixes an explicit reproducible RNG protocol.
adapter_metadata.padding: right padding only; native causal attention makes suffix padding invisible to scored tokens
adapter_metadata.bos_policy: Prepend exactly one BOS to context; no special tokens in continuation.

native_validation.early_readout: official transformer.C -> complete coda -> ln_f -> lm_head -> logit_scale

randomness.distribution: Normal(0, std^2) truncated to [-3*std, +3*std], then embedding_scale
randomness.seed_rule: little-endian first 8 bytes of SHA256('parcae-latent-v1|1234|' + str(question_id)), modulo 2**63
randomness.sampling: CPU float32 uniform, inverse normal CDF, then cast to model dtype
randomness.difference_from_native_rng: Preserves the distribution; omits the native discarded randn draw and fixes noise by question rather than batch shape.
randomness.sharing: Identical question IDs share initial-state prefixes across all candidates and policies

native_validation.native_check_note: Native forward receives the identical explicit latent through a temporary initialize_state override.
